impact: Easing oil helps the inflation picture at the margin, but with Brent still near $96 it does little to cool December Fed hike bets that weigh on yields, C's rate-sensitive peers and long-duration tech like PLTR and NBIS.
summary: Brent futures settled at $95.84 a barrel and WTI at $88.56 on Friday, Nov. 13, a second straight weekly decline. The IEA pointed to a growing global oil surplus as Gulf producers lift output around Hormuz risks and US inventories rose, even as Trump said the US could forgo an Iran deal.
title: Oil posts second weekly drop, Brent settles at $95.84
